label: Model and codec directory
help: Prepare the pinned 3.27 GB snapshot first. Runtime verifies local files and never downloads.

label: Inference Python
help: Dedicated Python 3.12 with pinned OmniVoice dependencies. Empty uses the app interpreter only if compatible.

label: Voice mode
help: Automatic voice, supported voice attributes, or an authorized reference plus its transcript.

label: Language code
help: Auto, or search an official language code/name. Language names shown in the list are upstream data; quality is model-dependent.

label: Voice attributes
help: Comma-separated: female, young adult, low pitch, british accent, whisper. One value per category. See README for all attributes.

label: Voice reference
help: Authorized, completed local audio, 0.5–20 seconds, at most 32 MiB. 3–10 seconds recommended. Source is preserved.

label: Reference transcript
help: Required exact words of the reference recording. No automatic Whisper model or hidden STT download.

label: Inference device
help: Explicit CPU or CUDA device 0. No silent device fallback; weights reload per request.

label: Model precision
help: CPU requires float32. CUDA also accepts float16/bfloat16. The codec stays float32.

label: Completed file format
help: Complete mono WAV at 24 kHz or Ogg/Opus at 48 kHz. This is not a live audio-stream port.

label: Completed audio directory
help: Empty uses this node’s persistent audio directory. Unique names, no overwrites or automatic deletion.

label: Target duration (seconds; 0 = automatic)
help: Native duration in 40 ms frames. Overrides speed. Padding counts toward the maximum; post-processing can shorten it.

label: Speaking speed
help: Native factor: above 1 speaks faster. Ignored when target duration is set.

label: Diffusion steps
help: 32 by default; 16 is faster. Every scheduled step and every audio code must complete.

label: Guidance scale
help: Native classifier-free guidance strength; default 2.

label: Time-step shift
help: Native diffusion schedule shift; default 0.1.

label: Position temperature
help: Native mask-position sampling; 0 is greedy, default 5.

label: Audio-code temperature
help: Native token sampling; 0 is greedy.

label: Codebook-layer penalty
help: Encourage earlier codebook layers to unmask first; default 5.

label: Padding per side (seconds)
help: Silence added at each end; included in the maximum output duration.

label: Fade per side (seconds)
help: Native fade-in/fade-out duration.

label: Target chunk duration (seconds)
help: Native punctuation-based chunking. Must not exceed the chunk threshold.

label: Chunking threshold (seconds)
help: Above this estimated duration, use all native chunks in order.

label: CPU threads
help: Bound native CPU parallelism.

label: Maximum audio duration (seconds)
help: Reject overlong estimates/chunks/results. Never silently crop speech.

label: Maximum segments
help: Refuse extra segments before generating them. All planned segments must be present.

label: Maximum context tokens
help: Bounds native attention allocation before each diffusion batch.

label: Maximum text characters
help: Reject oversized input. Inline pronunciation and non-verbal tags stay native.

label: Whole-request deadline (seconds)
help: Verification, loading, inference, encoding and publication share this deadline.

label: Address-space limit (MiB)
help: 0 disables the ceiling, otherwise at least 4096 MiB. CUDA reserves large virtual ranges; this is not reserved RAM.

label: Required available RAM (MiB)
help: Default 8 GiB; weight-based CPU/VRAM checks also apply. No memory reservation.

label: Pending requests
help: Active Runtime only. 0 rejects text while busy. Interrupt clears earlier requests.

label: Denoise conditioning
help: Native denoise token, not a filter on your reference file.

label: Preprocess reference
help: Native removal of long silence and punctuation completion, on the private reference copy only.

label: Post-process output
help: Native removal of long silences; may shorten the target duration. Fades and padding remain separate.
